summary: Behaviour-preserving refactor (router 0.40.0, implements proposed ADR-0115; ADR-0123 proposed): long-term memory is reached through a MemoryBackend Protocol with typed values (Fact, FactList, MemoryPage, OpState). B5 (router <-> Hindsight): the REST transport HindsightClient is unchanged - HTTPS or opt-in loopback HTTP only, no redirects, no ambient proxy or cookies, no forwarded client credential, bounded response size, bank ids matched against skirnir-<64 hex> before any request, and the authorize callback re-checks the live grant inside the concurrency slot right before sending. The new HindsightBackend only maps answers: it drops malformed results exactly as memory.py did before (non-object, non-text id or text, non-numeric score, a source list with non-text ids), keeps the first 100 recall results as before, and turns a non-text operation state or fact type into unknown/null (before: reflected to the client as received). B4/B5 policy is unchanged and still in the router for every backend: scope_for_principal/current grant checks (also after the backend call), the content filter on query, fact text, fact id and cleaned provenance, the recall_metadata provenance allow-list, recall_min_score, byte/fact/client budgets, single-source duplicates, the outbox states, revocation on 403 and bank change, the curator listing filter and the deletion lifecycle (delete only after completed/failed, reconcile by operation id). memory.py additionally bounds an answer to 100 facts for any backend. Indirect prompt injection paths are unchanged: recalled facts still reach a model only as the packed untrusted user-role data block (notice, escaped delimiters), prepare() and the ADR-0059 tools gate are untouched, and the gateway output is byte-identical (recorded answers). TM-05: memory is still inserted before the cloud checks; prepare() and the cloud path are not touched. Grants, data classes, memory_scopes writers (ADR-0060) and routes are unchanged; no new endpoint, log line, dependency or persisted field. Configuration: new key hindsight.backend with a closed list (only hindsight); any other value, including an import path, is refused by the parser and by open_backend, so configuration cannot select code to load (ADR-0118). B9: ci.yml only gains one self-test step; no permission, action or secret change. The added text names no organisation, host, address or person; test data are synthetic (example.com addresses, fake ids). Re-reviewed after merging main at bda97bb (container image #185, SQLite session store #187): the merge touched no memory code; the outbox worker now combines the typed MemoryBackend with #187's OutboxStore protocol, which both engines (PostgreSQL, SQLite) provide, so the worker's ledger calls, leases, revocation and deletion checks are unchanged and engine-independent. Only comments in memory.py and memory_outbox.py and one sentence in design/memory-reliability EN+DE were added for this.

tests.evidence: 20 tests OK: adapter contract against the synthetic loopback Hindsight (authorize false sends nothing; foreign bank ids refused without a request; failures are Problems with a fixed kind), policy on typed facts with a fake backend (min score, budgets, duplicates, filtered ids/texts/provenance, a revoked grant reaches no backend), backend selection (unknown names and an import path refused), gateway/REST byte compatibility. Mutations of the gateway status and of the adapter score each made it fail.

limitations: The real-Hindsight smoke test (integration_live_memory.py, live-memory.yml) needs a Hindsight deployment and an extraction model key; it was not run, only its skip path. Its code was adapted to build HindsightBackend.

Equivalence of the Hindsight adapter with the former inline parsing rests on code reading, the unchanged existing self-tests (which feed raw Hindsight shapes through the adapter) and recorded gateway/REST answers; it was not checked against every answer shape a real Hindsight version can produce.

Pre-existing residual risks are unchanged and not addressed here: TM-10 (a listed writer can plant false facts), TM-11 (direct access to Hindsight and its own model egress), TM-12 backup-order policy.
